records.question: Does Iver have anything that uses APIs?

result.answer:

records.question: Compare the ERP platform with the barcode warehouse system in plain English.

result.answer:
The Enterprise ERP Platform is the broader system: it brings together manufacturing operations, inventory, warehouse management, and business intelligence, with visibility from purchase-order receipt through work orders.

The Automated Barcode Warehouse System focuses on warehouse workflows, from receiving purchase orders to transferring inventory and managing work orders. It uses Zebra printers and handheld scanners to reduce manual processes.

In short, the ERP is the broader operations platform, while the barcode system is focused on warehouse workflows. Both list Python, SQL, and ZPL; the ERP also lists web2py.

The system handles everything from purchase order receipt to work order management, providing real-time visibility across all manufacturing operations.
Mobile-friendly barcode scanning solution for warehouse operations
